objective: Build a governed autonomous workforce that ingests a synthetic work order, decomposes tasks, assigns bounded agents, performs offline research and artifact generation, validates deliverables, and records exact-revision evidence without bypassing policy, authorization, or human review.

constraints.compute: existing CI and offline/local execution where feasible
constraints.privacy: do not expose secrets or private data

interfaces.name: GitHub repository
interfaces.scope: source inspection and review; exact commit/tree binding required

interfaces.name: GitHub Actions
interfaces.scope: CI only; service availability and billing limits may block runs

interfaces.name: AER and Red/Blue/Green reports
interfaces.scope: proposals only; authenticated evidence required before trust

scale_reliability_target.durability: evidence records must bind to exact revision and policy

prohibited: live security testing without separate authorization
